definitions: A digital environment, often web-based, that allows users to write and run code, visualize data, and document their work, specifically tailored for artificial intelligence and machine learning tasks.
A software application or platform that integrates code, output, and explanatory text in a single document, facilitating the development, experimentation, and sharing of AI models and analyses.
examples: She used an AI notebook to develop her new machine learning algorithm.
The data scientist shared his findings through an AI notebook.
An AI notebook is essential for reproducible AI research.
